strict_note: A2 CO profile selected-record co_id proof. This is synthetic RAM-field source provenance: the probe dynamically identifies the selected record for state_036, patches its co_id byte before redraw, and verifies repeated core-renderer reads of all 36 A2 compact power-name targets. It is stronger than a static xref but not natural all-CO route coverage or final pixel-level visual QA.
